decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no first project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero replies to two outreach emails (email:a26c6ca1, email:e8dfe102) or tickets. No signal of customer-side activity; internal note (slack:627dee90) only flags watching. Silence this complete rarely converts unaided in 8 days.

draft.subject: A hand getting Cedar Systems' first project up
draft.body:
Hi Sofia,

I know a new tool is easy to put off when the week fills up. Nothing's needed from you yet beyond a first project with real work in it — projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so that's the piece everything else hangs off. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'll walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything else that comes up.

Best,
Nadia
